Who we are

 About Stripe

 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

 About the team

 Sail Core builds Stripe's frontend platform—the data layer, navigation, observability, and developer tooling that 50+ product teams use to ship web applications, with the Dashboard being the largest. We are responsible for enabling a stellar developer experience for frontend engineers at Stripe. We're hiring a deeply technical product manager to own the platform strategy, drive cross-company modernization initiatives, and set the standard for frontend excellence at Stripe.

 What you'll do

 How should a platform team decide what to build when 50 teams depend on you and each one thinks their request is the most urgent? When do you invest in long-term architectural health versus shipping the migration that unblocks next quarter's goal? How do you make 9,000 files at initialization become a fast, traceable, joyful developer experience—without breaking production for millions of merchants along the way?

 Responsibilities

• Own the product strategy and roadmap for Stripe's frontend platform

• Drive the largest frontend modernization initiative at Stripe while holding the line on architectural quality

• Redefine frontend development with agentic tooling

• Define and track key metrics such as latency, build times, and reliability SLOs to make difficult trade-off decisions

• Be the product voice in deeply technical decisions such as API surface design, framework deprecation sequencing, extraction boundaries, and migration tooling

 Who you are

 You think in systems, not features. You go deep on architecture, you don't delegate to engineering. You're the person who reads the RFC before the meeting, asks why the error response looks like that, and frames migrations in terms of user outcomes, not just engineering milestones. You treat developer experience as part of the product, not a byproduct.

 We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

 Minimum requirements

• 7+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years on platform, infrastructure, or developer tools teams

• Strong technical fluency in frontend web development—you discuss JavaScript and TypeScript, React component models, build systems, and performance optimization with depth

• Experience driving large-scale migrations or platform transitions across multiple teams, including the sequencing, dependency management, and stakeholder alignment that make them succeed

• Demonstrated use of quantitative metrics to drive platform investment decisions—you've defined the metrics, not just tracked them

• Track record of partnering with engineering to make architectural trade-offs grounded in user impact

 Preferred qualifications

• Engineering background—you've written frontend code professionally and it still shapes how you think about product decisions

• Led or significantly contributed to a legacy extraction or monolith decomposition effort and understand viscerally why they're hard and where they get stuck

• Believe that fast software is the best software

• Naturally default to the platform solution over the one-off fix, but know when speed demands the opposite

• Explain what a cascading re-render is, why it matters, and what to do about it—to an engineer, a designer, and a VP, in three different ways

ABOUT BIP CAPITAL 
 BIP Capital is an integrated private market investment platform built to create and capture opportunities through BIP Ventures traditional venture anchor funds, an Evergreen equity BDC, and private credit offerings. With a distinctive multi-stage, multi-sector investment approach and a growing array of capital offerings, BIP Capital has generated consistent top quartile returns since 2009.
 ABOUT BIP VENTURES 
 BIP Ventures, the North American-focused venture capital division of BIP Capital, is a highly active venture capital firm based in the Southeast. BIP Ventures partners with extraordinary founders to drive exceptional outcomes. Since 2007, BIP Ventures has invested in the success of B2B software and tech-enabled service businesses at all stages of maturity. In addition to capital, it supports entrepreneurs with access to infrastructure, acumen, and talent, resulting in category-leading companies.
 OUR PHILOSOPHY 
 We are champions of our investors' goals and stewards of founders' dreams, but more than that, we are ethical, honest partners who serve, educate, and protect our founders and investors. We take on the challenges and complex conversations because we operate out of integrity and genuine care.
 ABOUT THE ROLE 
 We are looking for an enthusiastic, growth-oriented Associate Product Owner to join our BIP Wealth Tech team and contribute to the development of BIP's innovative technology products. This is a support-focused, execution-oriented role, an excellent opportunity for a motivated early-career product professional who is eager to learn, comfortable with shifting priorities, and ready to grow within a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
 As an Associate Product Owner for BIP Wealth Tech, you will work hands-on with our platform team, which is responsible for our core CRM platform development, supporting backlog management, writing user stories and release notes, managing our Jira Service Desk, performing QA, and collaborating closely with engineering and cross-functional stakeholders. You'll be the face of our support queue, responding to users effectively and building trust through clear, timely communication. We're looking for someone who is personable and engaging in stakeholder conversations, eager to learn how to drive UI adoption through demonstrated value creation, and comfortable getting hands-on with integrating third-party systems into existing workflows. The ideal candidate brings curiosity, decisiveness, and the ability to operate effectively in a complex domain, including finance and wealth management concepts.
 LOCATION: Hybrid with ability to be on-site when required out of Buckhead / Atlanta Office.
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 • Backlog Support: Assist in maintaining and prioritizing the product backlog under the guidance of senior team members, ensuring the team is focused on delivering high-value work.
• User Story & Release Note Writing: Write and refine clear, concise user stories with well-defined acceptance criteria; draft release notes to communicate product updates to stakeholders.
• Jira Service Desk Management: Serve as the primary point of contact and face of the support queue, owning day-to-day triage and resolution of service desk requests, maintaining a 24–48-hour SLA for responses and escalating as appropriate.
• Sprint Participation: Actively participate in grooming and sprint planning sessions; support efforts to keep the backlog 1–2 sprints ahead with 'ready' work.
• QA & Feature Validation: Perform acceptance testing and quality assurance on user stories to ensure features meet requirements and are free of critical defects before release.
• Small-to-Medium Feature Delivery: Take ownership of small and medium-sized features end-to-end, from writing epics and stories as directed through to release.
• Stakeholder Engagement: Serve as a day-to-day liaison between engineering and business stakeholders; build strong working relationships, support UI adoption efforts, and keep communication clear
• Multi-System Requirements Management: Manage requirements across multiple systems, including third-party integrations into existing workflows, ensuring they are clear, traceable, and aligned across stakeholders and workstreams.
• Feedback Collection: Participate in sprint reviews, gather and document stakeholder feedback to continuously improve the product and inform backlog prioritization.
• Documentation: Support the creation of process flows, user guides, and internal documentation as needed.
• AI Solution Building: Assist in identifying opportunities to build AI solutions that augment or enhance existing workflows, partnering with engineering to translate ideas into clear, actionable requirements.
 Requirements 
 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR 
 • Experience: 2 to 4 years of experience in product development, project coordination, or working within Agile/Scrum teams, specifically with software, platform, or web-based products. Experience in wealth management, fintech, or a related analytical or technology role will also be considered.
• Technical Acumen: Jira is the primary tool; Confluence is a plus. Experience with Rally or equivalent Agile platforms is acceptable. Basic familiarity with the software development lifecycle is expected.
• AI Fluency: Hands-on experience using AI tools, such as Claude, ChatGPT, or similar platforms, for prototyping, design exploration, or accelerating product workflows. Exposure to or interest in building AI solutions that augment or enhance workflows is a plus.
• Domain Comfort: Comfortable working within complex domains, including wealth management, finance, or venture capital concepts. You don't need to arrive as an expert, but you must be willing and able to learn quickly.
• Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to convey ideas clearly to engineers, stakeholders, and teammates. 
• People Skills: Friendly, curious, and emotionally intelligent. You build rapport easily, especially with engineers, are personable and engaging in stakeholder interviews and conversations, adapt to various personalities, and bring energy that improves team dynamics.
• Self-Starter Mentality: You take initiative, ask questions to fill knowledge gaps, and demonstrate resourcefulness. 
• Resilience & Adaptability: Comfortable operating within shifting priorities and frequent pivots. Open to feedback and quick to adapt to you, you see ambiguity as a normal part of a fast-paced environment.
• Analytical Skills: Ability to gather and interpret information to support product decisions and backlog prioritization. Strong communication and interpersonal skills are prioritized over deep analytics.
• Systems Integration Exposure: Exposure to or interest in integrating third-party systems into existing workflows is a plus; you don't need deep experience, but comfort learning how systems connect is important.
• Education: A bachelor's degree in business, computer science, or a related field is preferred, but equivalent work experience is welcomed.
 SUCCESS METRICS 
 • At 90 Days: Demonstrate foundational knowledge of our core CRM platform and other internal systems, and team workflows. Build positive working relationships with key stakeholders by supporting sprint ceremonies, triaging Jira Service Desk requests within the 24–48-hour SLA and contributing well-written user stories. Maintain a backlog with 1–2 sprints of groomed, ready work.
• At Six Months: Independently triage and resolve 90% of service desk requests within SLA, establishing yourself as a reliable face of the support queue. Contribute consistently to sprint ceremonies and maintain backlog management 3–4 sprints ahead. Take ownership of at least one small project end-to-end, delivering quality work from user story through release. Maintain accurate Jira documentation and actively support stakeholder feedback loops.
• At One Year: Demonstrate readiness to independently manage the backlog and own 1–2 active medium projects end-to-end. Begin contributing strategic insights to product decisions. Become a reliable resource across our core platforms, contribute to internal documentation, and show clear progress toward full Product Owner-level responsibilities.
 Benefits 
 WHY JOIN US 
 • Join a lean, agile team of startup-minded professionals who take ownership, move fast, and deliver high-quality, impactful products.
• Contribute to meaningful, innovative solutions, including our suite of internal and external platforms, that power the operations of a dynamic venture capital firm and its portfolio.
• Build and expand your product management expertise in an environment that values curiosity, autonomy, and continuous learning.
• Collaborate with smart, driven teammates who challenge each other to think bigger, move smarter, and constantly improve.
• Grow into a Product Owner or broader leadership role as we scale; your impact will be seen and valued every step of the way.
 WHY JOIN BIP CAPITA L
 • Top-quartile Performance: We are a leading venture capital firm in a vibrant tech ecosystem offering national prominence.
• Internal Growth: We foster critical thinking and promote internal advancement from day one.
• Unique Value Proposition: Our firm boasts a robust, defensible value proposition supported by a high-net-worth investor base.
• Merit-based Environment: We encourage you to bet on yourself, leveraging your merit to excel and thrive.
• Benefits: We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes competitive salaries, health and wellness plans, retirement savings options, paid time off, and professional development opportunities.
 BIP Capital is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, pregnancy, disability, age, veteran status, or other characteristics. BIP Capital is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status.
